rationale.consistency: Uses the same stdlib idioms (slices.Clone/Insert, maps.Clone) and comment style as the surrounding code; Helper field threading matches how options/warnings are already carried.
rationale.edge_cases: Nil options map, invalid order (error, no global write), chained order options via existingVal, and plugin init registration all handled; silently dropping a caller-supplied 'order' key is a debatable choice.
rationale.scope: Focused on the order leak, but cloning the whole options map in Setup is a broader behavioural change than strictly required (though it does satisfy the reuse requirement).
rationale.readability: Clear names (dirOrder) and explanatory comments, if a little verbose; the double delete of options["order"] needs the comment to make sense.
rationale.robustness: No shared mutable state after init: global order is only read, per-adaptation order is a fresh clone, no locks needed, no new panic paths; default order can no longer be aliased by RegisterDirectiveOrder.
rationale.maintainability: Explicit parameter threading through buildSubroute/serversFromPairings/extractNamedRoutes is easy to follow, but the nil-fallback to the global in buildSubroute creates a second, implicit path future code could rely on.
